text:
Senior SDET

Join QuantaPulse, a fast-moving startup building AI-driven observability for modern web platforms. We obsess over reliability: fast feedback, fewer outages, and quality that scales. We're hiring a Senior SDET to own automation across our test suite and help drive engineering quality end-to-end.

What you'll do
- Build, maintain and scale automated UI and integration test suites using Selenium and TestNG.
- Design robust test automation frameworks and reusable test libraries to accelerate release velocity.
- Collaborate with backend and frontend engineers to define test strategy, identify gaps, and ensure comprehensive coverage.
- Write and review automation code, implement CI integration, and debug flaky tests.
- Mentor engineers on test automation best practices and help establish quality metrics and SLAs.
- Contribute to release processes, triage production issues, and automate regression checks.

What we need (mandatory)
- Proven experience with Selenium.
- Strong background in Test Automation.
- Hands-on experience with TestNG.
- 8+ years of total software testing/engineering experience with a track record of shipping high-quality products.

Bonus points (preferred/good-to-have)
- Java
- Jenkins
- Cypress

Location and work mode
Fully remote within India.
